title: SimEvent
description: Every event the simulation can emit.

oneOf.description: Rigid-body contact between two entities (or an entity and the world).

normal.description: Unit contact normal in world space (from `a` toward `b`).

point.description: Contact point in world space, m.

oneOf.description: Lattice node displacement deltas. **Debug / replay only**; never sent over the network.

nodes_delta.description: `(node id, displacement delta in chassis space m)`.

oneOf.description: A detachable part group tore off.
A component's health changed noticeably (emitters should threshold, not spam).
A component failed (crossed its failure intrusion).

wheel.description: Wheel index (0 FL, 1 FR, 2 RL, 3 RR).

oneOf.description: The vehicle is a total loss.

pos.description: Where it happened, world m (v0.2.0; police witnesses / cameras).

oneOf.description: All glass of a body region shattered (v0.2.0; renderer, audio, net).

A body region crossed a damage threshold (v0.2.0; HUD silhouette, police "visibly
wrecked" heuristics). Thresholded like `ComponentDamaged`, not emitted every tick.
Police event (v0.3.0: typed; replaces `PoliceEvent { kind, payload }`).
Economy event (v0.3.0: typed; replaces `EconomyEvent { kind, payload }`).
The weather regime changed (v0.3.0, weather W-2; audio, HUD, replays, stakes).

forced.description: Forced by a scenario / admin rather than the schedule.

AccountId.description:
Durable account id (v0.3.0, F NET-5 / meta MC-1): allocated by meta at signup and stable
across instances, unlike the per-instance [`PlayerId`] slot. The server maps
`PlayerId → AccountId` at join.

BodyRegion.description:
Body region a lattice node belongs to. Used for damage accounting, repair billing,
detachable groups and the HUD damage silhouette.

oneOf.description: Left rear door (or rear half of the left side on 2-door cars).
Passenger cell (pillars, floor, firewall). Intrusion here drives total loss.

Bolt-on accessory ahead of / around the body: push bar, body kit (v0.3.0). Its own
detach group; no `HandlingEffects`; billed via `PriceTable::region_replace_cost`.

CarUid.description: Identifier of one owned car, unique within an account (never reused).

Component.description: Mechanical component that can be damaged by intrusion.

oneOf.description: Head and tail lights (cosmetic + night visibility).

CopXpReason.description: Activity a player cop earned or lost XP for.

oneOf.description: Minutes of patrol / pursuit without incident.
Kept pushing after the risk budget was spent.

CrewId.description: Identifier of a crew (allocated by `wp_race`, never reused).

oneOf.description: Crashed on its own (no racer contact this pursuit).
Wrecked after contact with a racer.
Pulled over: health below the disengage threshold.
Pulled over: bent wheel / flat tire.

DnfReason.description: Why a racer did not finish (they still rank above every DQ).

oneOf.description: The car became a total loss.
The race time limit ran out.
Did not finish within the window after the winner.
Abandoned the race to run from the police (AI entrants).

DqReason.description: Why a racer was disqualified (ranked below every finisher and every DNF).

oneOf.description: Outside the route corridor longer than the grace time (shortcut).
Moved faster than physically plausible between two samples.
Disqualified by the server / a marshal / an admin.

EconomyEvent.description: One auditable change to an account (`SimEvent::Economy`).

account.description: Durable account id (F NET-5 / meta MC-1).

EconomyReason.description: Why an account changed. Codes ([`EconomyReason::kind_code`]) are stable.

oneOf.description: 14: won the loser's car in a pink-slip race.
15: lost a car in a pink-slip race.
21: insurance paid part of a repair bill.
23: player chose to drive the car damaged.
25: a legit shop reported a wanted car (police add heat).

district.description:
District key of the shop (`data/economy/prices.toml [district_labour]`; still a
string in v0.3.0 because those keys are not all [`crate::DistrictId`]s yet).

oneOf.description: 26: damage report recorded at the end of a session.
33: bounty cleared at capture (police heat resets).
36: car moved to the pound (must not spawn).
39: car seized by the police (must not spawn).
50: cop bounty reward for a capture or assist.

level.description: Wanted level of the captured racer.

EntityId.description:
Simulation entity identifier (vehicles, debris, police units, traffic agents).
Allocated by `wp_sim`, never reused within one instance.

Legality.description: Legal status of an event; drives police presence and the stake risk premium.

oneOf.description: Sanctioned daytime event on a closed route: no police interest.
Rare illegal race in broad daylight: police presence forced to max.

PoliceEvent.description: Everything `wp_police` reports to the rest of the game (`SimEvent::Police`).

oneOf.description: Radio-log line (scanner audio, captain UI). Emitted for every assignment.

unit.description: First unit in pursuit (`None` = helicopter / captain).

oneOf.description: A pursuit ended. Emitted **before** the `WantedLevelChanged` that resets the level.

assists.description: Other units on the racer at a capture, ascending ids (empty for non-captures).

capturer.description: Unit credited with a capture (closest unit on the racer); `None` for non-captures.

level.description: Wanted level when the pursuit ended (before any reset).

oneOf.description: A unit appeared. `wp_sim` spawns a vehicle body for it when it drives units physically.
A unit is out of service.

sight_m.description: Approach sight distance at placement, m.

oneOf.description: A spike strip was placed (line collider from `a` to `b`).

sight_m.description: Approach sight distance at placement, m.

oneOf.description: A roadblock or spike strip expired or was cleared.
A vehicle ran over a spike strip; flagged wheels deflate.

wheels.description: Wheels hit, FL, FR, RL, RR.

oneOf.description: A unit attempted a PIT manoeuvre (contact is resolved by physics).

PolicePresence.description:
Police presence requested for a race event (v0.3.0, race R2); `wp_police` maps it onto
its dispatch tables.

oneOf.description: Police ignore the event (sanctioned, marshals on site).
Normal patrol behaviour for the area and time.
Elevated: extra patrols near the venue.
No unit had line of sight for the escape time.
The racer's car became a total loss while wanted.

RaceEvent.description: Everything `wp_race` tells the rest of the game (`SimEvent::Race`).

oneOf.description: The lobby for a scheduled event opened.

green_tick.description: Physics tick of the green light.

oneOf.description: A racer passed a checkpoint gate.

tick.description: Tick of the sample after the crossing.

oneOf.description: Too many meets at one venue: a patrol should be sent.

heat.description: Rolling meet heat at the venue.

oneOf.description: Control of a city zone changed hands (`None` = nobody controls it any more).

zone.description: Zone (territory is per zone, not per district kind).

RaceEventId.description: Identifier of a scheduled or ad-hoc race event (scheduler ids are `day * 1000 + n`).

RaceKind.description: What kind of race this is, with the parameters that change its rules.

oneOf.description: Point to point along a fixed corridor; first across the finish wins.
Closed loop; first to complete `laps` wins.

1v1 gap race in open traffic: a lead of `lead_m` wins outright, else the leader at the
time limit.
Open route: pass every checkpoint in order by any path, within the time limit.
Cross-city point to point, any path, through heavy traffic.
Point to point with cargo; cargo damage costs money, destroyed cargo is a DNF.

cargo_kg.description: Cargo mass added to the car, kg.

oneOf.description: Straight-line pass from a standing start.
Each racer on their own clock from the start gate; best elapsed time wins.

RaceResultRow.description:
One racer's final result as replicated (the judge's `RacerResult` minus drag / violation
detail).

cargo_damage_cost.description: Money owed for cargo damage (delivery only).

clean.description: Clean race (no contacts, civilian hits or collision violations; finished).

elapsed_subticks.description: Elapsed time, sub-ticks (1/1000 physics tick; finishers only).

oneOf.description: Informal street meet sprint: free entry, small purse.

RacerStatus.description: A racer's state in the race.

oneOf.description: Entered; race not over for them yet.
Crossed the finish (or won the outrun).

UnitId.description:
Police unit id (allocated by `wp_police`, never reused within an instance). Distinct from
`EntityId`: a unit may exist before `wp_sim` gives it a vehicle body.

UnitKind.description: Coarse police unit kind for events and views.

VenueId.description:
A race venue: index of a `wp_world` POI of kind `RaceStartGrid` (or a scheduler-local
venue index when no city is loaded).

ViolationKind.description: Kind of traffic violation detected by `wp_world`.

oneOf.description: Crossing a stop line on red.
Collision with another road user or property.

WantedLevel.description:
Police wanted level of a racer, derived from heat by `wp_police` (v0.2.0: moved here from
`wp_police` so economy, net and UI share it).

ZoneId.description:
One zone (district polygon) of the loaded city: index into `wp_world`'s
`RoadNetwork::zones`. Territory (crews) is per zone.
